headline: Open-weight models did not start the drop in price per unit of intelligence. They are a tailwind on a trend that was already underway. For the last few years, a few factors have driven price drops: 1/ Model builders distilling their best models into smaller ones, with cheaper inference 2/ Infra efficiency 3/ Competition between model providers You can see this pattern with every model company: Version x of the mid-size model = intelligence of version x-1 of the large model. Same intelligence for less $.
